Run after 2.1. Each point represents one biological sample. Shaded polygons are the convex hulls of the three biological samples in each predefined group, not confidence regions.

```{r setup}
source("CoPPRA_config.R", local = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
```


# Read saved PCA results



```{r read_pca}
paths <- stage_paths("PCA")
plot_folder <- paths$plots
list2env(readRDS(file.path(paths$data, "PCA_plot_data.rds")), envir = environment())
```

# PCA by predefined treatment group



```{r plot_peptide_pca_2d, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
pc1_variance <- round(pca_variance$Variance_percent[1], 2)
pc2_variance <- round(pca_variance$Variance_percent[2], 2)

pca_hulls <- pca_scores[, {
  hull_index <- chull(PC1, PC2)
  hull_index <- c(hull_index, hull_index[1])
  .(
    PC1 = PC1[hull_index],
    PC2 = PC2[hull_index]
  )
}, by = PCA_group]

group_colors <- c(
  Ctrl = "#1F77B4",
  R = "#D62728",
  U = "#2CA02C",
  RU = "#FF7F0E",
  Carrier = "#9467BD"
)

set.seed(20260616)

p_pca_2d <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = pca_hulls,
    aes(
      x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      group = PCA_group,
      fill = PCA_group,
      color = PCA_group
    ),
    alpha = 0.12,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "dashed",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = pca_scores,
    aes(
      x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      color = PCA_group,
      shape = PCA_group
    ),
    size = 4,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = pca_scores,
    aes(
      x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      label = label,
      color = PCA_group
    ),
    size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(Ctrl = 16, R = 17, U = 15, RU = 18, Carrier = 8),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Peptide-level PCA by Experimental Group",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_variance, "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_variance, "% variance)"),
    color = "Experimental group",
    shape = "Experimental group"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_pca_2d)

save_plot(p_pca_2d, "PCA_peptide_2D_grouped", 8, 6, dpi = 600)
```

# Variance explained



```{r plot_pca_variance_95, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
pca_variance_plot <- copy(pca_variance_95)
pca_variance_plot[, PC := factor(PC, levels = PC)]

p_pca_variance <- ggplot(
  pca_variance_plot,
  aes(x = PC, y = Variance_percent)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        round(Variance_percent, 1),
        "%\nCum. ",
        round(Cumulative_variance_percent, 1),
        "%"
      )
    ),
    vjust = -0.25,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "First Principal Components Explaining at Least 95% Variance",
    x = "Principal component",
    y = "Variance explained (%)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  expand_limits(
    y = max(pca_variance_plot$Variance_percent, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15
  )

print(p_pca_variance)

save_plot(p_pca_variance, "PCA_peptide_variance_first_95pct_barplot", 9, 6, dpi = 600)
```
